tabs.heading: Mentorship & Speaking
paras: I mentor designers who want to grow with clarity — not noise. Whether you’re early in your career or stepping into leadership, my focus is helping you understand how to think, how to decide, and how to navigate the realities of designing in an AI-shaped world.
This isn’t checkbox coaching. It’s direction, discernment, and honest conversation shaped by two decades in design and more than 200,000 mentorship minutes with designers from every background.

quotes.text: Amber identified a high-impact project that perfectly matched my skills, setting the stage for my immediate and future success with the team. Her proactive approach not only preserved my position but also demonstrated her exceptional commitment to her team's professional growth.
